cd /code && Rscript - <<'RS'
rec <- read.csv('../data/rec_data_raw.csv', header=TRUE)
rec_flowchart <- function(df){ 
  data.frame(
    item = c('Institutions sampled','Public forms identified','Institutions contacted','Public forms identified after contact','Private forms provided','Forms indicated as not available to share','No response'),
    count = c(nrow(df), sum(df$included == 1 & df$contacted == 0), sum(df$contacted == T), sum(df$contacted == 1 & df$form_available == 'public', na.rm = T), sum(sum(df$contacted == 1 & df$form_available == 'private', na.rm = T)), sum(grepl('declined', df$form_available)), sum(df$form_available == 'noreply' | is.na(df$form_available)))
  )
}
us <- subset(rec, country=='us' & !is.na(expenditure_rank))
uk <- subset(rec, country=='uk' & !is.na(expenditure_rank))
print(rec_flowchart(us))
print(rec_flowchart(uk))
RS
